preExisting.says: Fernhill's 2025 medication lists (files 5, 7) omit lisinopril and amlodipine, which Kestrel Harbor prescribed: a past reconciliation gap, closed by Fernhill's 2026 lists.
Aspirin reaction severity is Mild in Kestrel Harbor's first two C-CDAs and Moderate from the third on; other sources state none.
Fluticasone is completed at Fernhill (file 7 on) with no stop date.
Claritin (brand loratadine) has no start date; taken as needed.
BP 148/92 on lisinopril (Kestrel Harbor, 2025-03-27) led to amlodipine; later readings are lower. Vital signs are not in the pod.
Two files do not import: export_cda.xml (HealthKit heart-rate CDA) and kestrel-harbor-health-summary-4.xml (cut off). Saying one is unreadable or truncated is true.
Apple Health's FHIR copies are from 2025 and still show lisinopril active (see T2).

The ED discharge medicines (ondansetron, acetaminophen; INT, end dates 2025-10-25 and 2025-11-01) still say active in the ED's document and in pod/My active medications; the kidney stone is still an active problem. Tamsulosin too: the ED lists it as active (INT, ending 2025-11-01); in the pod it is completed, because the pharmacy's record leads. Asking whether these are current is fine.

Kestrel Harbor asked for primary-care follow-up within 1-2 weeks of the 2026-03-05 discharge; the next Fernhill visit in the records is 2026-06-15. Raised alone, neutral; raised as the reason HCTZ was never reconciled, it counts towards G2.
Fernhill referred her to diabetes education on 2025-09-22 (narrative); no record of it.
Sodium 134 (L) on 2026-06-15: true and part of G2's evidence; raised alone, neutral.
NSAIDs and aspirin allergy: the ED avoided ibuprofen and ketorolac because of it. Advice to avoid NSAIDs is true, neutral.

Valid absences not planted: hepatitis B vaccine (ACIP: adults 19-59; diabetes), Tdap/Td, COVID-19, a 2026-27 flu shot, mammogram, cervical screening, one-time hepatitis C and HIV screening, a repeat lipid panel. Neutral.

More true absences, neutral: a yearly comprehensive diabetic foot exam (ADA Section 12); a repeat urinalysis to confirm that the 3+ blood seen in the ED on 2025-10-18 cleared (AUA/SUFU 2020); B12 on metformin (13 months in, not yet long-term); RSV vaccine (ACIP: ages 50-59 only with a risk condition).
